menus:
  - id: menu.main
    key: menu.main
    udi: prismata.menu.main
    name: Main Menu
    title: Main Menu
    label: Main Menu
    position: Main
    order: 1
    type: main
    icon: "🚪"
    colourScheme: main-menu
    borderScheme: main-menu
    description: Minimal Prismata entry point.
    finalItemType: Quit
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.main.header
      text: Main Menu
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: main-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.main.footer
      text: Q: Quit
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: main-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.main.start
        key: main.start
        name: Start
        label: Start
        type: action
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.app.start
        executeTarget: start_prismata
        icon: "▶"
        colourScheme: default
        description: Start Prismata.

      - udi: prismata.menu.main.settings
        key: main.settings
        name: Settings
        label: Settings
        type: navigate
        order: 2
        selectionMethod: number
        action: navigate
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.menu.settings
        navigateTarget: menu.settings
        submenu_ref: menu.settings
        icon: "⚙️"
        description: Open the settings menu.

      - udi: prismata.menu.main.quit
        key: main.quit
        name: Quit
        label: Quit
        type: action
        order: 3
        selectionMethod: number
        action: exit
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.app.quit
        executeTarget: exit_application
        icon: "🚪"
        description: Exit Prismata.
